result.summary: Independently re-verified AC2's corrected GUI path against actual source, not against CODE-DESIGNER's summary. Confirmed: (1) lib/letflow/routers/identity.ex:182 has `authz_delete "/groups/:id/members/:user_id", :GroupsManage do handle_remove_member(conn, conn.params["id"], conn.params["user_id"], ...) end` -- the route the design cites is real. (2) lib/letflow/plugs/api_pipeline.ex:141 mounts this router at `forward("/identity", to: Letflow.Routers.Identity)`; grepped the whole file for `forward("/admin` and the only hit is `forward("/admin/services", to: Letflow.Routers.AdminServices)` at line 153 -- no `/admin/groups` mount exists anywhere, confirming the design's claim that the current web/src/api/identity.ts groupsApi.removeMembers/addMembers/list/get/update/delete/members all point at a dead prefix. (3) Read the actual current (still-unfixed, pre-implementation) web/src/api/identity.ts:55-58 -- removeMembers(id, userIds: string[]) does `void userIds` and calls `client.delete(`/api/v1/admin/groups/${id}/members`)`, exactly the broken shape the design describes as the defect it fixes; the design's proposed replacement signature `removeMembers: (id: string, userId: string) => Promise<void>` calling `DELETE /api/v1/identity/groups/${id}/members/${userId}` is unambiguous and matches the real route's single `:user_id` path segment exactly, no invented details. (4) Read GroupsPage.tsx lines 74-96, 207-236: removeMember mutation (line 85-86) currently wraps userId in `[userId]` to match the old array signature, and the button call site (line 234) already passes `{ groupId, userId }` correctly -- matches the design's claim that only the mutationFn body and identity.ts need to change, not the button/call site. (5) Confirmed the scope note is accurate: addMembers/list/get/update/delete/members all share the same /api/v1/admin/groups dead prefix (visually verified each line in identity.ts), all out of scope for REQ-378 since AC2 depends only on the revocation write path (removeMembers), and leaving siblings broken does not affect this requirement's acceptance -- no other GUI action REQ-378 depends on. (6) Diffed the full design doc against the pre-rework version's content (Sections 0-3, 5-10): identical apart from an added REWORK-1 banner; only Section 4 (now split into 4 + 4.1) changed. No implementation code (.ex/.tsx bodies) introduced -- all code-shaped blocks in the amended sections are @specs, cited existing/unchanged signatures, or excerpts of currently-shipped (broken) code being traced for the defect, consistent with the doc's own closing disclaimer in section 8. AC2 gap is fully closed at the design level; the fix is unambiguous enough for FRONTEND-DEV/ELIXIR-DEV to implement without guessing.
